info.title: Clinic API
info.description: REST API for the clinic management system. All responses use the envelope { success, message, data }. Errors use { success: false, message, errors? }.

get.description: Roles: admin, doctor, receptionist. DOCTORS only ever receive their own appointments, whatever filters they send.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Must be on or after date_from

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Prefix with - for descending. Ties are broken by start_time.

post.description:
Role: receptionist only. New appointments start as `pending`.

**422** means the request itself breaks a rule: doctor inactive, time in the past, doctor does not work that day, outside working hours, or time not aligned to the doctor's slots. **409** means the request is valid but the calendar changed: the doctor's slot is taken, or the patient already has an appointment at that time. A 409 usually means someone else booked first, so reload availability.

get.description: Roles: admin, receptionist, and the doctor it belongs to. Another doctor gets 403.

put.description: Role: receptionist only. Only pending or confirmed appointments can be edited (409 otherwise). The appointment does not conflict with itself.

get.summary: Free slots for a doctor on a date
get.description: Roles: all staff. Use this to build the booking screen: the returned `start` value is what you send as `start_time` when booking. Slots already in the past (when the date is today) are not returned.

200.description: Free slots (the list may be empty)

post.description: Role: receptionist only. Allowed only from `pending` (409 otherwise). No request body.
Role: receptionist only. Allowed from `pending` or `confirmed`. Cancelling frees the slot.

post.summary: Log in and receive an access token
post.description: Limited to 5 attempts per minute per email and IP. Public endpoint.

post.summary: Log out (revokes the current token only)

post.description: Role: doctor, own appointments only (403 otherwise). The consultation and the status change to `completed` are saved together or not at all. **409** if the appointment is not `confirmed`, was already completed, or its date is in the future. **Validation errors on prescriptions use dotted keys**, e.g. `prescriptions.0.dosage`.

get.description: Role: doctor (ANY doctor can read, for continuity of care). Admin and receptionist get 403.

put.description: Role: doctor, and only the AUTHOR of the record (403 for other doctors). Send only what changed. If `prescriptions` is sent it replaces the whole list.

get.description: Role: doctor only. Newest first. An empty history is a normal 200 with `data: []`. Items do not include the `patient` block.
Role: admin only. Cached in Redis for 5 minutes, so numbers can be up to 5 minutes old. Show `generated_at` to the user. `X-Cache` is HIT or MISS.
Roles: all staff. Only ACTIVE doctors are returned unless `is_active=0`. Cached in Redis for 10 minutes and cleared on any doctor or user change. The `X-Cache` header shows HIT or MISS.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Partial match on doctor name or specialization

parameters.name: available_on
parameters.description: Doctors who work on this weekday. 0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday

parameters.name: is_active
parameters.description: Send 1 or 0. The words true/false are rejected.

post.description: Role: admin only. Create the user (role `doctor`) first, then attach the profile. Profile and schedules are saved together or not at all. There is no DELETE: deactivate with `is_active: false`.

get.description: Roles: all staff. Returns inactive doctors too.

put.description: Role: admin only. `user_id` cannot be changed and is ignored. If `schedules` is sent it replaces the whole old set.

get.description: Roles: admin, doctor, receptionist. Soft-deleted patients are never returned. The search parameter matches one word at a time against name, patient number, phone and email.

post.description: Role: receptionist only. The patient_number is generated by the server and cannot be sent.

put.description: Role: receptionist only. Send only the fields that changed.

delete.description: Role: receptionist only. The record is hidden, not erased. Existing appointments keep showing the patient.

get.description: Role: admin only. Newest first, 15 per page.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Partial match on name or email

parameters.name: without_doctor_profile
parameters.description: Send 1 to list only users that have no doctor profile yet. Use with role=doctor when creating a profile.

post.description: Role: admin only. To make a doctor, create the user with role doctor, then create the doctor profile (Doctors section).

put.description: Role: admin only. Send only the fields that changed. Sending role replaces the current role.

delete.description: Role: admin only. Revokes all tokens of the user. An admin cannot delete their own account (403). A user with related records cannot be deleted (409).

allowed_transitions.description: Statuses this appointment may move to, based on its CURRENT STATE only. It does not consider the caller's role.

consultation_id.description: Set once a consultation has been recorded for this appointment

patient_id.description: Must exist and not be deleted

start_time.description: H:i. Must be one of the doctor's slot starts (see availability).

AppointmentUpdateInput.description: Patient and doctor cannot be changed. Cancel and rebook instead.

slots.description: Free slots only. Empty if the doctor does not work that day, is inactive, or is fully booked.

patient.description: ABSENT in the patient history list (the patient is already known there)

diagnosis.description: Required on create. On update it can be changed but never blanked.

prescriptions.description: On update, a sent list REPLACES the old one. An empty array clears it.

end_time.description: H:i format, must be after start_time

user_id.description: Create only. The user must have the doctor role and no profile yet.

schedules.description: One entry per working day, no repeated days. On update, a sent list REPLACES the old one.

Unauthenticated.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked token

Forbidden.description: Logged in, but the role or record ownership does not allow this

message.example: You do not have the required role

NotFound.description: The record does not exist (message names the resource, e.g. "Patient not found")

Conflict.description: The request is valid but conflicts with current state (slot taken, illegal status change)

ValidationError.description: Validation failed. "errors" maps each field to its messages.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit hit. Read the Retry-After header for seconds to wait.

sanctum.description: Token returned by POST /auth/login. Expires after 8 hours.

tags.name: Patients
tags.description: Patient records (receptionist writes; all staff read)

tags.name: Doctors
tags.description: Doctor profiles and schedules (admin writes; all staff read)
